description: Fly.io is a cloud platform for running applications on Firecracker-based virtual machines across global regions. It also offers Sprites, persistent Linux sandbox environments for AI agents and exploratory code execution.
summary: fly.io exposes the Fly Machines REST API at `api.machines.dev`, the `flyctl` CLI, plus Sprites surfaces under the Fly ecosystem: a Sprites REST API at `api.sprites.dev/v1` and a hosted MCP server at `https://sprites.dev/mcp` authenticated via OAuth.
